note: Claude Code ignores an unrecognized agent frontmatter key without an error, so a typo such as reasoning_effort for effort runs the def at inherited session settings. Two readers use this file: install/Install-Harness.ps1 -Audit and test/agent-frontmatter-keys.test.ts. Keys are case-sensitive.
extensionNote: writeScope is core's own key, not a platform key. core/claude/hooks/agent-write-scope.ts reads it to confine a subagent's writes to a scratch folder.
